title: Immortal Shores

uniqueness_answers.rejected_suggestion: Live shared 3D co-op city sandbox / pure idle clicker without negotiation / real-time action combat MMO.
uniqueness_answers.why_play_twice: Persistent hourly production, barge ETAs, province blessing windows, monument pressure, and the long climb to Eternal Name retirement.
